difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y the lemma lists four equivalent formulations of ind-quasi-affineness: (1) the definition (every quasi-compact open of X with quasi-separated image condition maps quasi-affinely), (2) the test on affine opens of the base, (3) the test over some qcqs open cover of the base, (4) the test over every qcqs open of the base; in particular being ind-quasi-affine is Zariski local on the base. The retained proof is written: (1) iff (2) unfolds the definitions with Morphisms, lemma characterize-quasi-affine; (2) => (4) takes U, V as in (4), notes U -> V is quasi-compact (Schemes, lemma quasi-compact-permanence), tests on affine V' inside V where the fibre product V' x_V U is quasi-compact so (2) applies and characterize-quasi-affine re-assembles; the same argument yields (3) => (4) except that quasi-affineness of V' x_V U -> V' is derived from (3) applied to the composition through V_j together with the permanence lemma (Morphisms, lemma quasi-affine-permanence) along the quasi-separated map V' -> V_j (Schemes, lemma compose-after-separated); (4) => (2), (4) => (3) are immediate. Retained author proof at lines 19559-19582.
